name: Consultations
description: Sit down with a consultant — not a queue. We take time with your history, review any scans or results you bring, and give you a clear plan in plain language. No referral needed.

name: Laparoscopy
description: Minimally invasive surgery through incisions measured in millimetres — meaning less pain, shorter hospital stays and a faster return to work and family.

name: Minor Theatre
description: Straightforward procedures done properly: in, treated, and home the same day. You'll need someone to accompany you where sedation is used.

name: Colonoscopy & Endoscopy
brief: Diagnostic & therapeutic, with full prep support
description: A clear look inside, without guesswork. We guide you through bowel preparation step by step before the day, and discuss findings with you before you leave.
